items.text:
Send an address as a 0x hex string such as 0x401000. A JSON integer below 2^53 is a decimal value. A string of digits only is an error, because the server does not guess the base.

The server reads an address text by the first rule that matches. Rule order: JSON integer, 0x hex, ID, exact symbol name, section name, default name, name@0x<hex>, term with a 0x offset. Use sym:<exact name> for a symbol name that looks like another form.

A name with more than one match gives AMBIGUOUS_NAME. Each candidate value resolves to one match. An unknown name gives NOT_FOUND with the closest names. An address outside the memory regions gives ADDRESS_UNMAPPED with the nearest mapped addresses.

Output addresses are lower case 0x hex strings. The result field resolved_from tells the rule and the matched text.
